description: This file contains utility functions for GUI management in the BORIS software, including theme detection, window geometry saving/restoring, icon setting, and window resizing/centering.

methods.name: theme_mode
methods.description: Returns 'dark' or 'light' based on the OS theme by inspecting the application's palette.

methods.name: save_geometry
methods.description: Saves the geometry of a given QWidget to an ini file located at ~/.boris.

methods.name: restore_geometry
methods.description: Restores the geometry of a QWidget from the ini file or applies default size if not available.

methods.name: set_icons
methods.description: Sets icons for various actions in the GUI based on the theme mode.

methods.name: resize_center
methods.description: Resizes and centers a window on the primary screen, adjusting size if it exceeds screen dimensions.
